speaker: humphrey_larkham
text: Three rolls, Master Shakespeare. Gaunt, York, and the Queen. One late change runs through them like damp through plaster. I have laid them so you can see the damp.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Show me the damp, Humphrey. I will not pay for a likeness. I will pay for the rolls if they disagree.

speaker: humphrey_larkham
text: They disagree. Here is Abel's shortened cue. Here is your own. Nick's entrance hangs on the cut word, and the cut word is not the same mouthful in the two of them.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I would rather learn the new cue by ear this morning than wait on clean paper. My ear has it, near enough to be dangerous.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Paper first, then mouths. I have seen two versions of a speech live through a season and fight each other on the stage. I will not keep a third fight in the book.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I back him, Nick. Paper first. And I back the copying out of the stock. Eightpence to Humphrey. It is not generosity. It is the plain cost of being the author of a change.

speaker: humphrey_larkham
text: Eightpence makes the three agree. I will mark each corrected roll with the small sign Abel and I settled in the winter, so a stale copy can be known on sight.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: If the sign is small I shall miss it, and then I shall say the old line at the door and shame the scene.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thou wilt not miss it if thou lookst at the sign before thou lookst at the cue. The ear is second. The paper is first.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The king is billed again for Thursday week. Two versions in the company's mouths is how a bill turns into a quarrel. I am not carrying a quarrel across a week.

speaker: humphrey_larkham
text: Gaunt's roll, first. The boy enters on the cut word. If York still holds the long cue, the boy walks into a speech that has already sat down.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Then York's is the dangerous roll. I can hear the end of the old one from the door, and the end is a trap if the door is early.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: York's is the one I rewrote. Abel shortened it to save a breath. Mine spends the breath. The Queen's roll takes the entrance from whichever of those two is still alive. Only one of them may live.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Yours. The book will not hold both, and the stock is not paying eightpence for a copy we mean to set aside.

speaker: humphrey_larkham
text: Then I copy yours onto the three, and the shortened cue is the stale one. The sign will say so, without a speech about it.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: May I speak the new cue once, after the paper, so my mouth knows what the eye has agreed to?

speaker: john_heminges
text: After. Not before. Mouths are the second cost, and they cost nothing. The eightpence is the first cost, and it is a cost.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Once, lad, when the sign is on all three. Not the whole act. The act has already been rehearsed into two shapes. I am tired of both shapes being true at once.

speaker: humphrey_larkham
text: You shall have them before you are painted for the afternoon. The weight is on the trestle. Three rolls, unrolled, and the cue written until it agrees with itself.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: What do I do with the old line, if it is still sitting in my head when I come to the door?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thou leavest it in thy head and out of thy mouth. The paper is the mouth we have agreed.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Eightpence, out of the stock, entered where copying is entered. I will not have it called a gift in any man's book, including mine.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nor in mine. I agree the cost. I do not put my hand in my purse on the stage and call that the author's duty.

speaker: humphrey_larkham
text: The small sign, on this one, and this one, and this one. A roll without it is last winter's quarrel. It is not today's.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I see the three marks. I do not ask what the sign is the shape of. We have agreed it, and that is enough of a shape for me.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Good. Do not describe it to the company. Abel knows it. Humphrey knows it. Description is how a private sign becomes a public argument.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Then the morning is done. This afternoon is a play you are in, Will. It is not this king.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I know which afternoon is mine. Leave the rolls under the weight until the ink will not smudge. I have someone else to write tonight, and she is not in these three.
